    Changelog

    Source: NEWS.md

    SigDoTS 0.2.5.8

    First version of the package.

    • sigdots() runs the test, from an expression matrix and coordinates, a Seurat object or a SpatialExperiment object; sigdots_control() holds the settings that rarely change; sigdots_prepare() makes the expression matrix from raw counts.
    • print(), summary(), domains(), add_domains() and plot() (domains, candidate domains, tree, spatial correlation) read the result.
    • The example dataset sigdots_example; four tutorials and a real-data application.
    • Two ways to compute each test’s p-value: Monte Carlo (the default) and a normal approximation that needs fewer simulated datasets (pvalue_method = "normal_adaptive").
    • Results do not depend on the number of cores.
    • Where the spatial parameters cannot be estimated (too few spots in a part of the tree), that part is left untested and marked, and the rest of the tree is still tested.
    • Where the spots of a part of the tree fall into separate pieces on the nearest-neighbour graph, the pieces are joined by their closest spots before the tree is built.
